summary: Round 16 re-check, written 27 Sep ~08:50Z. At the 08:30:44Z poll header, probes 43/44 were still PENDING. Three old conclusions were re-read against the D2 fact that probe 42 exp70b (K2 + forkmid 4.5) displays 0.954 with an ATTRIBUTABLE UP. That means exp70b is above the team best B0 = max(P36, #35, K2) and so strictly above #37 on public. (A) REVISED. L9 and the R13-A1 A-only extension keep a 0.954 class-B file out of the insertion slot. For exp70b that is now the weaker choice. exp70b is K2 plus one removal rule. In the lab that rule removed 40 of 676 safe-division forks and 0 of them were TP; lab TP midpoints reach at most 3.65 um. It measured +0.00013 pooled on the no-lowrefine bed, +0.0004 on the lowrefine exp64 44b6 bed, and it is now positive on the unseen public embryo. So {exp70b, #38} weakly dominates {#37, #38}. The gain is tiny (private L4 prior ~0.08/0.77/0.15) and the change is post-hoc, so it needs a logged user letter; without one the pair stays {#37, #38}. There is no submit. (B) The fork-removal closures (forkblob FAIL, ANTIPAR FAIL, the ADDENDUM M veto break-even 'FP:TP >= 7.7') were computed on the CONTROL bed (J 0.129), not on the insertion stack K2 ships (ins35 J 0.192) and not at public J (~0.3). The correct break-even is p* = J/(1+J): 0.114 / 0.161 / 0.197 / 0.231. On the ins35 bed, forkblob's sign flips from -0.00013 to about +0.00018; ANTIPAR stays slightly negative. The reasoning error is real, but the closures stand for 29 Sep: the lab has only 7 and 5 evaluable forks, dc0.30 showed that lab precision does not carry to public, and R8, the FREEZE and the closed list all apply. This goes to the post-deadline list as a method fix. (C) The L5v2 chain 'exp70a NEU -> lp30 not POS -> BASE none -> no combo' held no evidence about lp30 on K2. The UP test compared exp70a with P36, which already carries lp30. The only public lp30 read, P36 > #35, is confounded by #35's possible 7.5 h degrade. Verdict: the outcome is UPHELD (no exp70c, FREEZE, closed list), with a corrected reason. The note matters for the private read and for any user question about a combo. No mechanism reaches R8.

findings.what: OLD VERDICT: finals rule L9 (26 Sep 20:49Z) and the D1/D2 read sheet. A class-B variant becomes V* only with a display >= 0.955. The R13-A1 (3) 'A-only extension' let a 0.954 file with an attributable UP replace #37 only for exp70a (lp30). D2 (07:41Z) therefore kept {#37, #38}: 'exp70b (< 0.955) is never V*'. The reasons were: no choice between near-copies by 0.001; public-tuned knobs may not transfer; forkmid itself closed on power (T9 25 Sep: ORIGINAL + L3 FAIL). WHAT CHANGED: (1) exp70b has an ATTRIBUTABLE UP (count 43 -> 44, 6 TeamIds passed). So exp70b > B0 = max(P36, #35, K2) >= #37 on public unrounded. That is a proven strict order on the unseen public embryo. Our kernels are deterministic, so the 0.001-noise argument does not apply (curator (c), 25 Sep). (2) The removal is the J-invariant kind. v2's div-cap verify says an FP-fork removal is positive at any J. In the exp60 lab, forkmid 4.5 removed 40 of 676 eligible safe-division forks: 0 TP, 1 evaluable FP, 39 ignored. Lab TP midpoints max out at 3.65 um (0 of 16 TP forks >= 4.5 um; 95% upper per-TP rate 0.17). ins35_forkmid45 vs ins35: 6bba 23/22/65 vs 23/23/65 (+0.0002), 44b6 identical. exp64 (the lowrefine bed, 44b6, 71 clips) gives fm45 +0.0004. The lowrefine worst case (4 TP if every readmitted-touching row is counted adverse) is a bound, not a measurement. The K2-stack bed (exp64) and the public read are both >= 0. (3) Same K2 recipe plus one change: dummy nodes 121,252 = K2, forks 74 vs 75. Ledger L (7.41, 7.58] h, 'insertion gate 8.0 h did NOT fire', family safetail ADMIT (a). (4) 4.5 um was fixed on exp39 lab graphs before any public read, and it is one pre-registered rung, not a tuned public threshold, so winner's curse is mild (1 of 4 class-B rungs). (5) Tie rule: exp70b is not a copy of any file. Its only possible exact private tie is with #37 (when no evaluable private fork is removed), and then the team score is the same either way. NEW VERDICT: REVISED. On the evidence, exp70b is the better file for the insertion slot. {exp70b 56592350, #38 56563534} weakly dominates {#37 56563521, #38}: public order is proven, private E[delta] is about 0..+0.0002, P(private delta < 0) is about 0.08-0.15, and the P(above the x138 block) hedge through #38 is unchanged. The stake is small, and by rule the change is post-hoc to L9/R13-A1. It is not a new mechanism and not a forkmid re-proposal: no build and no submit, only the choice between two already-scored files.

findings.what: OLD VERDICT: forkblob (ADDENDUM L4) FAIL: vetoed 150/676 (TP 1 / FP 6 evaluable), pooled div_J 0.1290 -> 0.1271, score -0.00013. ANTIPAR (M4) FAIL: vetoed 113 (TP 1 / FP 4), J 0.1290 -> 0.1250, score -0.00034. DNVETO was closed as the 'same mechanism class'. The ADDENDUM M rule was 'lab veto break-even at J_div 0.129 is FP:TP >= 7.7'. The fork-REMOVAL family was then recorded as 'exhausted on exp60' (IDEAS row 6). WHAT CHANGED: (1) exp70b (forkmid) shows that a geometric fork removal can be positive on the unseen public embryo. (2) The break-even for removing forks with evaluable precision p is p < J/(1+J), and it rises with J. All three gates were scored against the CONTROL bed (16/25/83, J 0.129), which is x138 without the insertion. But every finals file that could carry a removal is on the insertion stack (ins35 pooled 25/31/74, J 0.192, an in-sample upper bound). Public J is ~0.3 (probe 26 upper bound 0.36), and v2's private mixture has mean J ~0.245. Recomputed break-evens: J 0.129 -> p* 0.114 (FP:TP >= 7.8); J 0.192 -> 0.161 (>= 5.2); J 0.245 -> 0.197 (>= 4.1); J 0.30 -> 0.231 (>= 3.3). With the same vetoes on the ins35 bed, forkblob gives dJ +0.0012, about +0.00012 division and about +0.00018 with its +0.00006 edge: the sign flips from the recorded -0.00013. ANTIPAR gives dJ -0.0018 (about -0.00012 with edge) and turns positive only at J >= 0.25. NEW VERDICT: the reasoning was PARTLY WRONG (wrong base J), but the closures are UPHELD for 29 Sep. (a) The evaluable counts are 7 and 5. Wilson 80% intervals are p in [0.04, 0.38] and [0.06, 0.49], which straddle every break-even. (b) dc0.30 showed that removed-fork precision measured in the lab does not transfer to public: lab 6bba 0 TP / 6 FP, public -0.005. So a lab p cannot sign a removal on private. (c) forkblob's dose is 22% of forks, larger than dc0.30's ~27%-of-dummy-forks move, so its public variance is of the -0.005 order. (d) R8 (12:00Z), the FREEZE, and the orchestrator's closed list. The one lesson that carries: a removal rule is only safe when its lab removal set is p ~ 0, as with forkmid, not merely below a J-specific break-even.

findings.what: OLD VERDICT (D1, 27 Sep 04:58Z; L5v2): exp70a (K2 + leaf prune 0.3) = 0.954 with no UP, so unit a is NEU, knob lp30 is NEU, BASE is none, and there is no combo (exp70c = K2 + lp30 + fm45, sha a7271d4e, stays unbuilt). The only possible finals route for lp30 (the A-only extension) lapsed. In practice, 'lp30 NEU' was read as 'lp30 has no public support on K2'. WHAT CHANGED / RE-READ: (1) The UP test compares a probe with the team best B0 = max(P36, #35, K2). P36 = x138 + lp30 + ungated insertion, and P36 > #35 unrounded (round 4 record: rank 164 -> 155). So exp70a had to beat a file that already carried lp30. Its NEU was close to certain whatever lp30 does on K2, and the D1 entry itself says 'P36 already carries lp30'. (2) The only public lp30 contrast, P36 > #35, is CONFOUNDED. #35's latency (6.72, 7.73] h may have crossed x138's 7.5 h guard (R12P-1), which can only lower #35. (3) The D2 UP gives exp70b > B0 >= exp70a, so on public fm45-on-K2 > lp30-on-K2. That is an ordering of two knobs, not the sign of lp30. (4) Private side: lp30 is lab-positive on both embryos (44b6 +0.00165, 6bba +0.00075). But it removes readmitted leaves, which makes it a node-count lever, and node-count levers flip sign with annotation density (R12-NF: 0.79% on 44b6 vs 5.20% on 6bba). NEW VERDICT: the OUTCOME is UPHELD, with a corrected reason. No exp70c: FREEZE (R15-A1 (2): no other ladder submit unless the user asks), the closed list (leaf prune on x138, forkmid), and class B needs >= 0.955 to be V*. But 'lp30 NEU' must not be cited as evidence against lp30. The public evidence on lp30 is null (one confounded contrast plus one structurally blind test). For the finals it does not matter: exp70a carries the insertion, so it cannot replace #38, and RC-A's exp70b beats it on public for the insertion slot.
